visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a person's hand holding a blue physical 'Isetan Mitsukoshi Group Guest Card' against a plain, light-colored background. Large yellow warning icons and bright red/black text overlays appear prominently at the top and bottom of the frame. (2) The scene cuts to a brightly lit department store interior focusing on a printed informational poster titled 'New! Digital Shopping Coupon!'. The poster features various logos like WeChat and QR codes, explaining the transition from physical cards to digital vouchers. (3) A medium shot follows, showing a customer's hand holding a smartphone next to a passport at a service counter. A staff member's hand is visible pointing towards a QR code displayed on a desktop monitor for the customer to scan. (4) The visual shifts to a high-resolution screen capture of a mobile app interface. It displays a 'Shopping Coupon' with a unique barcode, an expiration date, and traditional Chinese text explaining the terms of use. (5) The final scene shows a wide shot of a large, brightly illuminated brand banner for Iwataya Mitsukoshi Department Store. The banner features the brand's signature logos and product photos, set against a clean, modern retail background.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video serves as an informative guide for tourists traveling to Japan, specifically announcing that the physical Isetan Mitsukoshi Guest Card has been discontinued in favor of a digital app-based coupon. It visually demonstrates the steps required to obtain the discount, including downloading the app and verifying a passport at the tax-free counter, while maintaining an energetic and helpful tone through upbeat music and clear text overlays.
